title: Shopping list 1
estimate: Trimmed on 18 Nov to the exact recipe amounts. Not priced yet: check it in the Woolworths app and send me the total.

items.text: Chicken thigh fillets, 800 g (korma)
Beef mince, 1 kg (tacos 500 g, ragu 500 g)
Salmon fillets, 2 (about 300 to 350 g, tray bake)
Raw peeled prawns, frozen, 300 g (fried rice 250 g, plus a few for Thursday's breakfast)
Canned pink salmon, 1 x 210 g (catch-up plate uses half)
Brown onions, 6 (korma 2, tacos 1, ragu 1, fried rice 1, dahl 1)
Garlic, 13 cloves (2 small heads)
Ginger, 4 tsp grated (korma, dahl)
Capsicum, 1 (tacos)
Carrots, 4 (ragu 2, fried rice 2)
Broccoli, 2 heads (tray bake)
Potatoes, 600 g (tray bake)
Lemons, 3 (tray bake, dahl, plus tacos wedges and hummus)
Avocados, 2 (tacos 1, prawn toast 1/4)
Banana, 1 (1/2 needed, weetbix breakfast)
Apple, 1 (1/4 needed, oat porridge)
Lettuce, 1 small (tacos)
Baby spinach, about 150 g (korma, omelette, dahl)
Eggs, 6 (5 needed: fried rice 3, omelette 1, scrambled egg 1)
Natural full-fat yoghurt, 400 g (buy the smallest tub)
Tasty cheese, 110 g (tacos 1 cup, baked beans toast 1 tbsp; buy the smallest block)
Firm tofu, 300 g (fried rice 200 g, catch-up plate 100 g)
Basmati rice, 1.1 kg (5 1/2 cups dry: korma, fried rice, dahl)
Dried pasta shapes, 500 g (ragu)
Small soft tortillas, 8 (tacos)
Wholemeal bread, 6 slices (buy 1 loaf and freeze the rest)
Rolled oats (3 tbsp needed, oat porridge)
Weet-Bix (1 biscuit needed; buy the smallest box)
Iron-fortified infant cereal (2 tbsp needed in total)
Red lentils, 500 g (ragu 200 g, dahl 300 g)
Canned black beans, 1 (tacos)
Canned chickpeas, 2 (korma, hummus)
Canned crushed tomatoes, 4 (korma 1, ragu 2, dahl 1)
No-salt-added baked beans, 1 can (3 tbsp needed)
Low-salt soy sauce (adults at the table with the fried rice; recipe gives no amount)
Ground almonds, 60 g (korma)
Tahini (about 3 1/2 tbsp in total: tray bake, hummus, catch-up plate, yoghurt breakfast)
100% smooth peanut butter (1 tsp in total)
Korma paste (3 tbsp needed; check the label for salt)
Ground cumin (5 tsp in total: korma 1, tacos 2, dahl 2)
Ground coriander (2 tsp in total: korma 1, tacos 1)
Ground turmeric (2 tsp: dahl)
Smoked paprika (2 tsp: tacos)
Garam masala (1 tsp: dahl)
Dried mixed herbs (1 tbsp: ragu)
Frozen peas and corn (1 cup: fried rice)
Frozen mixed berries (a few needed: yoghurt breakfast)
Olive or neutral oil (about 9 tbsp across the week)
